immutablePhase0PostRegionSnapshot.algorithm: sha256(filename + NUL + bytes + NUL, sorted by filename)

method.access: read-only copied Anvil region files and hash-bound local evidence only
method.exactCondition: complete block-state census inside each local survey box; six-connected present-fabric and air components; direct-below contacts; block-entity locations
method.entranceCandidate: exact door/gate/trapdoor states plus two-block-clear standable boundary crossings
method.observationCandidate: standable cells two to six horizontal blocks outside the recorded core, outside the minimum planning exclusion, with a sampled all-air ray to exposed present fabric or the absent-site datum
method.routeCandidate: bounded cardinal two-block-clear walk with dy 0,+1,-1; no dig, tower, parkour, sprint, jump control, or planning-exclusion entry
